## Joining an existing fragment sequence

`fragment-index` says where the first layer sits, so the stack can start after
fragments that came before it.

::: {.r-stack-fragments fragment-index="2" gravity="top"}
::: {.a}
A layer keeps its own classes.
:::

::: {.b}
And its own attributes.
:::
:::
